extDesc.message: Live captions + translation for interviews and meetings, recording & summaries — 100% on-device, no bot, no cloud.

onbStep1Desc.message: So your own voice is captured alongside the other side. Audio is processed and stored only on your machine.

onbNotice.message: Note: call-recording laws differ by region — some places require consent from all parties. You are responsible for saved recordings; a "captions only, no saving" mode is always available.

onbStep2Title.message: Step 2 — Which language should we translate into?

onbStep2Desc.message: Captions appear bilingual: original + your translation.

onbStep3Desc.message: Press the button and say anything — you'll see the caption + translation right here.

onbDone.message: Done! Open your meeting tab (Google Meet, Zoom web…) and click the extension icon to start.

vwDataPanelDesc.message: Everything lives in this browser on this machine. No server, no uploads.

vwDeleteAllConfirm.message: Permanently delete ALL meetings (audio + transcripts + summaries)? This cannot be undone.
